gloss: no vacancy; fully booked; all rooms occupied

definitions.gloss: no vacancy; fully booked; all rooms occupied
definitions.explanation: A state in which all rooms in a hotel, inn, or similar facility are occupied and no more guests can be accommodated.

examples.japanese: ホテルは{満室|まんしつ}だった。
{連休中|れんきゅうちゅう}はどこも{満室|まんしつ}で{予約|よやく}が{取|と}れない。
examples.english: During the holiday period, everywhere is fully booked and I can't make a reservation.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{旅館|りょかん}は{半年|はんとし}{前|まえ}から{満室|まんしつ}になることもある。
examples.english: Popular inns can be fully booked as early as six months in advance.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on signs at hotels and parking garages (for the latter, {満車|まんしゃ} is used instead). The opposite is {空室|くうしつ} (vacancy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満室|まんしつ}になる (to become fully booked)
- {満室|まんしつ}{御礼|おんれい} (fully booked — thank you)
- {空室|くうしつ}/{満室|まんしつ} (vacancy / no vacancy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{満車|まんしゃ} (no parking spaces available), {満席|まんせき} (no seats available), {満員|まんいん} (full capacity of people).
